headline: Iran War Odds Through 2026
status: The IRGC's claim to have hit the LPG carrier NV Sunshine on the southern Hormuz route is still not independently confirmed, and no new ship hit was reported overnight. Trump again calls talks with Tehran "productive" while Iran reviews the US reply, and a single-source report says the Houthis have mined Bab el-Mandeb. No tripwire fired and odds are unchanged; war by Nov. 3 stays at 55%.
change_note: Oct. 9: War by Nov. 3 45% → 55% after the IRGC's first named claim since September (NV Sunshine, unconfirmed). Oct. 7: Escalated war now means a step the war hasn't taken yet: ground forces in Iran, strikes on Iranian civilian infrastructure, or a major Gulf export hub, power or desalination plant knocked out for a week. Another July-style strike campaign counts as limited war. Escalated by Nov. 3: 14% → 7%; by year-end: 20% → 12%. Vance says Iran must make a "meaningful" cut in enrichment capacity: year-end deal 15% → 13%, MOU-style by Nov. 3 11% → 10%. War by Nov. 3 60% → 45% under the stricter rule (an official claim of a specific, confirmed attack, or a US strike). Blink #10 re-derived: 70% blink, 30% no blink. Price ranges recentred on the futures: gas ≥ $4.50 on Nov. 3 37% → 13%, Brent (Jan.) ≥ $100 65% → 37%.

bets.cond: The IRGC or Artesh officially claims a specific attack that is independently confirmed
bets.effect: War by Nov. 3 resolves yes; escalated ~{nov3:escalated_war}%

bets.cond: Iran accepts US sequencing, or round two is set with text
